持续施法 - 使用生命汲取时，帕格纳吸取目标敌方单位的生命值，并获得其视野。

向队友施放可以将自己的生命值转移给队友。

scepter_loc.en: Reduces cooldown by %abilitycooldown%s. When targeting an enemy hero, Pugna reduces their outgoing spell damage by %spell_amp_drain_rate%%% per second up to a maximum of %spell_amp_drain_max%%% and increases his own, up to a maximum of %max_spell_amp_drain_pct%%%. When draining through a Nether Ward using Shard, the rate of increase/decrease is %spell_amp_drain_rate_ward%%% instead. Debuff lasts %spell_amp_drain_duration% seconds.
scepter_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少%abilitycooldown%秒。以敌方英雄为目标时，帕格纳每秒降低他们%spell_amp_drain_rate%%%技能伤害输出，最高可达到%spell_amp_drain_max%%%，并且自身的技能伤害输出提升，最高可达到%max_spell_amp_drain_pct%%%。魔晶升级下对幽冥守卫施放时降低和提升的速率为%spell_amp_drain_rate_ward%%%。负面效果持续%spell_amp_drain_duration%秒。

shard_loc.en: Life Drain can target your Nether Ward, causing life drain to refract to all enemy heroes within %abilitycastrange% units of the ward for %shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%% of its normal value. The effect is interrupted if the ward is destroyed.
shard_loc.zh: 生命汲取可以对幽冥守卫施放，使生命汲取可以折射至守卫附近%abilitycastrange%范围内所有敌方英雄，造成%shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%%效果。守卫被摧毁后效果将会中断。

subject: dazzle_poison_touch
definition: 提高技能造成的伤害
evidence: 伤害格挡类技能不能减少该技能伤害。

context.description_en: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
context.description_zh: 施放一股锥形的毒素，可以打击多个敌方单位。造成持续伤害和减速。每当目标受到戴泽的攻击，负面效果的持续时间都会刷新，减速效果也会提升。
notes_en: The damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.
notes_zh: 伤害格挡类技能不能减少该技能伤害。

subject: doom_bringer_devour
definition: 提高技能造成的伤害
evidence: Stolen creep abilities have %bonus_aoe_pct%%% increased AoE and %bonus_spell_amp_pct%%% increased spell amplification.
获得的野怪技能拥有%bonus_aoe_pct%%%额外作用范围和%bonus_spell_amp_pct%%%额外技能增强。

context.description_en: Consumes an enemy or neutral creep, acquiring any special abilities that it possessed. If alt-cast is activated, Doom will not acquire the creep's abilities. Duration is equal to the cooldown.
context.description_zh: 消化一个敌军或中立生物，获得其特殊技能。开启多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，末日使者不会获得其技能。持续时间与冷却时间相同。
notes_en: Gives Doom the original bounty of the creep, along with the bonus gold.
If you devour a creep without abilities, you'll keep the abilities you had previously.
notes_zh: 末日使者将获得该生物的正常金钱，还有技能的额外金钱。
如果吞噬的单位没有技能，之前获得的技能将会保留。

shard_loc.en: Devour has %AbilityCharges% charges and can target Ancients. Stolen creep abilities have %bonus_aoe_pct%%% increased AoE and %bonus_spell_amp_pct%%% increased spell amplification.
shard_loc.zh: 吞噬拥有%AbilityCharges%点能量点数，能以远古生物为目标。获得的野怪技能拥有%bonus_aoe_pct%%%额外作用范围和%bonus_spell_amp_pct%%%额外技能增强。

subject: rubick_fade_bolt

evidence: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage.
拉比克制造一道强大的奥术能量流，在多个敌方单位之间流动，造成伤害并降低他们的攻击力和技能伤害。

context.description_zh: 拉比克制造一道强大的奥术能量流，在多个敌方单位之间流动，造成伤害并降低他们的攻击力和技能伤害。每次跳跃造成的伤害递减。
